texts.en: Despite the seemingly frozen surface of [From.GetName], the planet's orbital path around [From.GetStarName] leaves it blistering at several hundred degrees. Under normal circumstances this would sublimate the ice on [From.GetName]'s surface. However, extreme gravitational pressure exerted by the planet's ultra-dense core keeps the water in a solid state, resulting in a planet of fiery hot ice.
